title: pipelines → studio's projector: a title for an untitled session
description: From API 1.43 (contracts/README.md, Sessions: titles and naming). Subject `evt.pipeline.<session_id>.named` (stream EVT, studio's durable studio-pipelines), Nats-Msg-Id `name:<session_id>`, job_id = the session id, owner_id = cmd.pipeline.name's. The title is model text, checked by pipelines (2-5 words, at most 60 characters, one line, no quotes or markup) and again by studio, which applies it only to that owner's session while its title_source is default or prompt (a user's rename always wins), then appends a `session` event to the session's log.
